name: Lover's Call [CANCELLED] [ANNOUNCEMENT]
source:
A cozy fantastical romance visual novel about a magical phone, a mystery, and helping people find love - and maybe your own? 

In the midst of a bustling city...

A special phone connecting people's hearts...

A mysterious operator...

Fourteen different people...

A voice cutting through the night, coming through your phone...

At the end, when you call, who will answer?

RELEASE DATE: [s]Mid 2023 Early 2025 Late 2027 Early 2028 Mid 2029 Early 2030[/s]  CANCELLED!!! SEE ANNOUNCEMENT

一部舒适的奇幻浪漫视觉小说，讲述一部神奇的手机、一个谜团，以及帮助人们找到爱情——也许还有你自己的爱情？

在繁华的城市之中…

一部连接人心的特殊电话……

一位神秘的操作员…

十四个不同的人…

手机里传来一道声音，划破夜色……

最后，当你打电话时，谁会接听？
